test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was selected for Saraswati Samman’2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sharankumar Limbale.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sharankumar Limbale was selected for Saraswati Samman’2020.**
 
• It was instituted by KK Birla Foundation in 1991 and is recognized as the most prestigious and highest literary award in the country.
 
• The Saraswati Samman is an annual award for outstanding prose or poetry literary works in any of the 22 languages of India listed in Schedule VIII of the Constitution of India
 
• Noted Marathi writer Dr Sharankumar Limbale received Saraswati Samman, 2020 for his book Sanatan.
 
• Sanatan is an important social and historical document of the Dalit struggle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Noted Sindhi writer Vasdev Mohi was honoured with 29th Saraswati Samman in 2019 for his short stories collection:- Chequebook
 
• Telugu poet K Siva Reddy was honoured with the prestigious Saraswati Samman, in 2018 for his work Pakkaki Ottigilite(Turning Aside While Lying Down)’.
 
• The 27th Saraswati Samman 2017 was conferred upon eminent Gujarati poet Sitanshu Yashaschandra for "Vakhar" (Poetry collection)
